Refund and Replacement Policy

Every AKARA piece is printed to order, one at a time, just for you. Because of this, we do not offer cash refunds on printed goods. We do make things right when something goes wrong.

Free replacement for defects

If your order arrives damaged, misprinted, or with a print or fabric fault, we replace it free of charge.

  • Tell us within 7 days of delivery.
  • Send 2 to 3 clear photos of the issue and the order number to amit.rath@akara1.com or WhatsApp +91 99935 18528.
  • We confirm within 2 business days and ship a replacement. You do not need to send the faulty piece back.

Size exchange

Picked the wrong size? We exchange once, free, within 7 days of delivery.

  • The tee must be unworn, unwashed, and with tags on.
  • Message us with the order number and the size you need. We arrange the pickup.
  • The new size ships once the original is picked up. Exchanges depend on the size being in stock with our print partner.

What we cannot accept

  • Returns for change of mind, or because the colour looks slightly different from your screen.
  • Items that are worn, washed, altered, or without tags.
  • Requests made more than 7 days after delivery.
  • Cash refunds on any printed item.

Cancellations

Orders go to print within 24 hours. Message us right away if you need to cancel. Once printing has started, the order cannot be cancelled.

Refunds in rare cases

If we cannot replace a defective item, or an order is lost in transit and cannot be re-shipped, we refund the full amount to your original payment method within 7 to 10 business days.

Questions: amit.rath@akara1.com · WhatsApp +91 99935 18528

Shipping Policy

Where we ship

We currently ship only within India. International shipping is not available yet.

Cost

Shipping is free on every order, to every pin code we serve.

How long it takes

Each piece is printed to order. Printing takes 2 to 4 business days. Delivery takes 5 to 8 business days from the day you order. Remote pin codes may take a little longer.

Tracking

You get an email with a tracking link when your order ships. You can also message us on WhatsApp at +91 99935 18528 with your order number.

Payment

We accept prepaid payment only: UPI, debit and credit cards, net banking, and wallets, through Razorpay. Cash on Delivery is not available right now.

Failed deliveries

If the courier cannot reach you after repeated attempts, the parcel comes back to us. We will contact you to arrange a re-ship. A second re-ship may carry a courier charge.

Wrong address

Check your address at checkout. If you spot an error, message us within 12 hours and we will correct it before the parcel ships.

Privacy Policy

AKARA (akara.studio and this store) respects your privacy. This page explains what we collect and why.

What we collect

  • Your name, shipping address, email, and phone number, so we can deliver your order and contact you about it.
  • Payment details are collected by Razorpay, our payment processor. We never see or store your card or UPI details.
  • Basic device and browsing data, such as pages viewed and IP address, through Shopify's standard analytics and cookies.
  • Any message you send us by email or WhatsApp.

How we use it

  • To print, ship, and support your order.
  • To send order and delivery updates.
  • To send occasional news about new drops, only if you opt in. You can unsubscribe anytime.
  • To improve the store and prevent fraud.

Who we share it with

Only the partners needed to fulfil your order: Shopify (store platform), Razorpay (payments), our print and shipping partner (Qikink, India), and the courier. We do not sell your data to anyone.

Cookies

We use cookies to keep your cart, remember your preferences, and understand how the store is used. You can block cookies in your browser, but checkout may not work without them.

Your rights

You can ask us to show, correct, or delete the personal data we hold about you. Email amit.rath@akara1.com. We reply within 7 business days.

Data retention

We keep order records for as long as required by Indian tax and accounting law. Marketing data is deleted when you unsubscribe.

Changes

We may update this policy. The date below shows the latest version.
